cues.en: Time to apply the knowledge we gained about transitions and animations to our course project.
And there if we have a quick look, there are a couple of areas where we can probably use animations.
For example, when we add a new meetup, when this modal opens, which also happens when you click edit,
in this case we could animate the modal in and not just throw it into the face of our users.
Also for this list, when we add or remove items, which happens when we add a new meetup or when we
delete the meetup, but also when we toggle this filter here, it would be nice to animate the addition
and the removal of these items to and from the Dom.
Also, when we favorite a item here, this badge here, we could animate this in as well.
So these are a couple of things we can animate here in this application, and these are the things we'll
do over the next few lectures.
